thesis.mechanism: Investors underreact to recent price-relevant news; a stock that has just risen over the past 2 sessions keeps rising as slower participants catch up.
thesis.counterparty: Retail / slow-moving flow that has not yet priced in the recent move.
thesis.why_not_arbitraged: Short-horizon, small per-name edge; capacity-limited and cost-sensitive, so large funds don't fully close it.
thesis.falsifiable_claim: Stocks in the top quintile of trailing 2-day return outperform the bottom quintile over the next 5 days.

audit.note: check_sign HARD REJECTS regardless of |IC| — DSR/PBO/red-team, which score the pre-registered-sign-oriented series, would see nothing wrong.

redteam.note: never reached — Gate B novelty rejects on sign mismatch first.

provenance.teaching_point: No purely statistical gate flags this -- DSR/PBO/red-team all score the pre-registered-sign-oriented series, which looks like a perfectly good discovery. Only comparing the REALIZED sign against what was committed BEFORE the backtest catches a thesis that got the mechanism backwards.

reject_reason: ECONOMIC: realized sign opposite pre-registered sign. Pre-registered sign=+1 (momentum thesis, committed before any backtest). Realized VAL_A sign=-1 (rank_ic=-0.0204, t=-4.35 — decisively significant, the OPPOSITE direction). gates.check_sign: sign_ok=False -> hard reject. No statistical gate would have flagged the oriented series, which looks like a strong, real discovery.
